
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/yanmonull/p/19093129" title="发布于 2025-09-15 16:02">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Opensuse Leap 15.6 + P104显卡 安装Cuda环境</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<h2 id="_"></h2>
<h3 id="忠告">忠告</h3>
<p>首先敬告各位，Opensuse leap对于Nvidia的驱动支持安装很不方便并且比较老旧，我个人还是建议切换到Debian系来做开发，会方便的多，企业使用Debian/Ubuntu，个人用户可以用LinuxMint。</p>
<h3 id="安装显卡驱动">安装显卡驱动</h3>
<ol>
<li>
<p>添加Nvidia的软件源：sudo zypper addrepo --refresh '<a href="https://download.nvidia.com/opensuse/leap/$releasever" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">https://download.nvidia.com/opensuse/leap/$releasever</a>' NVIDIA</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>安装驱动，因为P104是一张非常老的卡了, G06的驱动无法使用，我们安装nvidiaG05</p>
</li>
</ol>
<ul>
<li>
<p>检索判断是否存在可用软件包：zypper se x11-video-nvidiaG0* nvidia-video-G05*</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>安装驱动包：zypper install nvidia-video-G06</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>判断安装是否成功: nvidia-smi会列出显卡信息。</p>
</li>
</ul>
<ol start="3">
<li>安装Cuda：请注意此老版本驱动只能适配Cuda11版本，所以下载Cuda11.8.<a href="developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit-archive" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">历史版本链接</a></li>
</ol>
<pre><code>&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;wget https://developer.download.nvidia.com/compute/cuda/11.8.0/local_installers/cuda-repo-opensuse15-11-8-local-11.8.0_520.61.05-1.x86_64.rpm
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sudo rpm -i cuda-repo-opensuse15-11-8-local-11.8.0_520.61.05-1.x86_64.rpm
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sudo zypper refresh
&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;&nbsp;sudo zypper install -y cuda
</code></pre>
<ol start="4">
<li>
<p>将nvcc程序手动移动/链接到/usr/bin目录下，sudo ln -s /usr/local/cuda/bin/nvcc /usr/bin/nvcc，并执行nvcc命令</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>写个小程序测试以下：</p>
</li>
</ol>
<pre><code>#include &lt;stdio.h&gt;

void __global__ gpu_print(){
    const int bid = blockIdx.x;
    const int tid = threadIdx.x;

    const int id = threadIdx.x + blockIdx.x*blockDim.x;

    printf("%s, block %d, thread %d, idx %d\n", "Hello world GPU",bid,tid,id);
}

int main(){
    gpu_print&lt;&lt;&lt;2,2&gt;&gt;&gt;();
    cudaDeviceSynchronize();
}
</code></pre>
<p>执行编译： nvcc test.cu -o test，测试结果：./test</p>
<h3 id="可能遇到的问题">可能遇到的问题</h3>
<p>注：系统请不要轻易升级内核，否则会导致cuda和nvidia驱动出现问题，如果不小心升级了，可以使用以下命令进行解决：</p>
<pre><code>sudo apt install dkms
sudo dkms install -m nvidia -v &lt;驱动版本例如 525.147.05&gt;
</code></pre>

</div>
